title: Crew-hours rows as one table
heading: Every Row Family Is a Table of (row, column, coefficient)
cases: each start variable gets the crew-hours of its k-th week of work in week start + k
the entries are sorted by week, then by column
work that falls after the last planning week gets no entry
a week of zero hours in a task's profile gets no entry
a variable's column is its position in the options table, even when that table's index has gaps
